title: Operations and security release readiness dossier
workflow: Cross-index all operations draft packages and historical platform decisions
Request exact executed controls for CI/CD, secrets, network and backup
Review security threats, roles, tenancy and regulator/data residency applicability
Perform independent restore, outage, performance and reconciliation exercises
Attach signed reviewer decisions and unresolved exception register
Approve only safe bounded capabilities with complete DoR evidence
invariants: 20 documented OPS checkpoints are not 20 accepted infrastructure work packages
Unexecuted test case cannot be marked passed
No invented HSM or penetration-test certification
Failure to reconcile financial balances blocks dependent go-live
Bank-specific external settlement keys and permissions require actual authority
Every acceptance refers to exact Git commit and real proof
P0 status must be retained until signed evidence resolves
acceptance_tests: Run index reconciles all OPS archive paths
Reject test pass absent execution log
DR recovery must preserve journal and dedupe
Security exception cannot waive failed financial integrity
independent_gate: Independent legal/CFO/CISO/Operations/QA approval, current institution profile and genuine executed acceptance evidence.
